content: Hi all wondering if anyone have interests in considering connecting graph to statistical model. I was thinking about providing a common foundation connecting graphical models to finite random variables, random fields, and percolation on lattices. That means it should support the property with infinite graph
I opened a PR related to some initial thought on supporting markov property (Glocal -> Local -> Pairwise) for infinite graph, wondering if someone is interested in any kind of discussion :)
